body:
Founder real-time, live: 'theres some issue with fireball its not casting' -> 'i get the cast target thingy but i click and nothing' -> 'and it doesnt go on cooldown' -> 'also his auto attack is broken' -> 'abraham'. Root cause 1: arena_tick_attack_targets' windup-START trigger (team-mode, the founder's own live match) was hardcoded to ARENA_HERO_GARY only -- S202-34 excluded Abraham from the old melee loop at 6 sites but never added him to this one, so he never auto-attacked at all, which is likely why the fireball itself looked broken too (nothing about his kit visibly worked). Root cause 2: bot_cast_kit_if_ready's Abraham case still ran the pre-rework kit, calling arena_toggle_w without ever setting a ground target first -- bot Abrahams have never cast a fireball since the rework landed. Verified via direct headless repros: confirmed broken before, confirmed a real homing shot fires and lands damage after (foe hp 100->92). Also finished Kite String (S202-34 trinket, 4% auto-attack range, 3333 flow), found as real uncommitted half-finished work while checking for in-flight state -- header fields existed with no catalog entry or stat wiring. All 4 build paths verified green, full 1099-check test suite, 0 failures, real mingw cross-compile. REDGARDEN d4fd6c7 (fix+item) + ea0787a (earlier CI wiring fix for abraham_fireball_mod missing from Windows cross-compile).

⚓ ☃
title: Fixed live bug: Abraham never auto-attacked (windup-start hardcoded to Gary); bot AI stale for W rework; added Kite String
